name: TaiVision-pretrain-1M-v2.0
description: TaiVision-pretrain-1M-v2.0 is a large-scale image collection intended for pretraining vision models (roughly 1M images), curated for diversity and downstream transfer performance. It is used to train foundation vision encoders and evaluate transfer learning on standard vision tasks.
evaluation_method: downstream transfer evaluation (linear probe / fine-tuning accuracy)
reputation: A community-shared pretraining corpus on Hugging Face; useful for model pretraining but not as prominent as larger, widely adopted web-scale corpora.
